description: Submit the final structured verdict: under items, exactly one answer for each checklist item, each with its checklist id and the findings on that item inside it; observed findings under findings; and your own opinion (recorded only).

ItemDisposition.description: Dispositions an item may carry. `observed` belongs to observed findings only.

ItemFindingDisposition.description: Dispositions a finding inside an item may carry.

Location.description:
A location as a tagged record with nullable fields (see SPEC "Frames and locations"). The
fields `kind` needs are set; every other field is null.

bbox.description: `[left, top, right, bottom]` as fractions of the frame's width and height, each between 0 and 1 (never pixels).

frame.description: A frame id as given in the conversation, for example `raw:candidate` or a crop a tool returned.

kind.description: `bbox` and `polygon` take coordinates; `view` takes yaw, pitch and fov; `whole_image` and `absent` take nothing.

polygon.description: Three to sixty-four `[x, y]` points as fractions of the frame's width and height, between 0 and 1.

yaw.description: Degrees, -180 to 180, for `view` on an equirectangular frame.

ObservedFinding.description: Something noticed under an `observe` rule: never a finding on an obligation, which goes inside the item it bears on.

allowed_by.description: Exemption id when `disposition = allowed_change`, null otherwise.

evidence.description: Tool call ids from this run used as evidence.

location.description: Where it is; findings always have a location.

obligation_ids.description: One to eight observe rule ids as numbered under Obligations, for example `SF7`; never checklist item ids.

reason.description: One to a few sentences; at most 600 characters.

input_schema.description: The submission, schema version 3. `items` lists one answer for each checklist item, each with its id and the findings on it; `findings` holds observed findings only. Every property is required; optional values are nullable.

items.description: One answer for each checklist item, each naming its id as the checklist lists it.
What the model said about one checklist item, and the findings on it. Items carry no obligation ids: the checklist owns them.

allowed_by.description: Exemption id; required when `disposition = allowed_change`, null otherwise.

evidence.description: Tool call ids from this run used as evidence.

findings.description: Findings on this item, each where it is: give them when the item is a violation, cant_tell or allowed_change; otherwise an empty list.

items.description: A finding on this item: a violation, a change it may allow, or what cannot be told, where it is. It bears on the item's own obligations, so it cites none.

allowed_by.description: Exemption id when `disposition = allowed_change`, null otherwise.

evidence.description: Tool call ids from this run used as evidence.

location.description: Where it is; findings always have a location.

reason.description: One to a few sentences; at most 600 characters.

id.description: The checklist item id exactly as listed, for example `chk:ob:SF1@candidate`.

reason.description: One to a few sentences; at most 600 characters.
